heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
text: Subsection 230(2) of the Act applies for the purposes of an action for passing off arising out of the use of a protected international trade mark in the same way as it applies for the purposes of an action for passing off arising out of the use of a registered trade mark.
